logp.method_description: Partition coefficients of the platinum(IV) complexes were determined in an octanol/water system. Briefly, platinum complexes were dissolved and diluted to 50 μM in water. Equal volumes of the drug solution and n-octanol were shaken in vortex for 15 min, and after centrifugation (4000 rpm, 15 min) the platinum content in the aqueous layer was analyzed by ICP–AES (Model ELAN5000, Perkin Elmer, Norwalk, CT, USA). Partition coefficients were expressed as the log of the partition ratio of the total platinum in octanol to that in the aqueous layer.
